turns.text: When you leave the hotel, turn right and continue straight for two blocks.
turns.zh: 你从酒店出来以后，往右拐，然后一直往前走两个街区。

turns.text: Right turn and two blocks straight.
After that, you'll see a large park on your left hand side.
turns.zh: 过了那儿之后，你左手边会看到一个很大的公园。

turns.text: Walk past the park and you'll reach a main intersection with traffic lights.
turns.zh: 走过公园，你就会到一个有红绿灯的大路口。
